title: Buyer First Is a Behavior, Not a Statement: Carol Mahoney on What Most Companies Get Wrong
summary: The episode explores buyer-first methodologies in sales, examines AI coaching applications for sales teams, and highlights mindset's importance in driving sales results. Carol Mahoney discusses understanding buyer perspectives, developing AI coaching technology, and how psychological orientation influences performance outcomes.
keyQuote: Buyer-first approach requires actual behavioral change, not merely strategic positioning statements.
guestBio: Sales coach, Buyer First author, and Unbound Growth founder who transitioned from eliminating sales roles to becoming a prominent data-focused authority on seller adaptation to modern buying patterns.

chapters.title: The Role of Mindset in Sales
